scope: 산업 제어반 스타일의 게임 화면 배치 비교용 이미지 5종
basePrompt:
Create one polished GAMEPLAY UI LAYOUT PROPOSAL for TownGrid / 타운그리드, a Korean isometric pixel-art town-building, production-chain and logistics game. This is a full in-game screen composition design, NOT a component sheet, NOT a website, NOT a promotional poster. Wide landscape screenshot-like composition, target 16:9. Reference image 1 shows the current actual game: use its crisp pixel village assets, isometric fixed camera angle, green landscape, road, river and modest buildings as the same scene in all options. Reference image 2 is the approved INDUSTRIAL CONTROL PANEL component style. Keep that style in all options: teal enamel #235f63, dark steel #153d42, quiet ivory #f1eddf reading surfaces, orange #ee701b primary actions, small hard bevels, purposeful sparse corner rivets, square corners, crisp simple icons. This task changes POSITION and SIZE of interface elements, not the approved visual style. Prioritize genuine playable map visibility and hierarchy.

Recompose the actual HUD rather than copying screenshot 1's layout. Keep the original scene's modest zoom and one-building-per-tile scale, a small river at lower left, trees and rocks, diagonal dirt road with cart, small orange timber and teal-roofed production buildings at center, three cream cottages below road. Do not invent a giant ornate fantasy city, panoramic illustration, modern skyscrapers, 3D terrain, new characters, or a giant portrait. Pixel game map fills all space behind/within the intended map viewport; there must be no blurred wallpaper. Use clean Korean UI typography, short correct labels, numbers that are legible. Make controls physically compact: this is a playable screen, not giant cards over a map. No marketing headline. Only tiny discrete concept label at top edge: option number and Korean title. No explanatory paragraphs or arrows outside the game UI. No browser frame or watermark.

Common information across layouts: compact region selector '하벤 개발구'; resource counters gold '2,500', wood '52', stone '30', water '16', wheat '8'; '1일째' with pause, 1×, 2×, 4× speed keys, 1× selected orange; a small goal '개간 농노' and '판재 생산 0/12'; one compact wheat delivery notice '밀 납품' with '8/6' and small action '납품'. Four main actions '시장', '건설', '확장', '세계', 건설 selected orange. Small help/settings and camera controls rotate left/right, plus/minus. Construction categories '기초', '주거', '농축산', '가공', '운송' with 기초 selected. Catalog entries using existing pixel art style: '창고 80', '흙길 4', '우물 60', '벌목장 90', '채석장 100', plus dim locked '제철소'. Use coin icon for cost. One small selected-sawmill information area '제재소', '생산 중', log→plank icons, teal 65% progress, '00:18', '생산 중지' secondary button. This is comparative mockup content, not a dense table. Separate building placement selection from operational status cleanly. All controls inside image safe margins. Orange should only accent selected or main actions. Maps dominate, no statistics charts, no dashboard grid, no new mechanics, no personnel recruitment, no full-screen modal.

Follow the following exact layout geometry. The specified arrangement is the main design difference.

designs.name: 하단 통합형
designs.summary: 건설 목록과 시설 정보를 하단 한 줄에 모음
designs.tradeoff: 가로 시야가 넓고 조작 위치가 일정하지만 지도 아래쪽이 줄어듭니다.
designs.layout: OPTION LABEL '01 · 하단 통합형'. A clean full-width TOP STRIP only 7% screen height: region at left, resources center, time plus settings at right. A single full-width BOTTOM CONSOLE occupies final 24% height, map fills middle 69%. The bottom console is split 70/30: left 70% has ONE combined navigation/category line on top and SIX small building cards in a single row; right 30% is a compact sawmill inspector with horizontal log→plank recipe, progress and small stop key. Four main action buttons are at the LEFT of the console header, category labels continue along it. Do NOT add a separate second action toolbar below this console. A small two-row objective/delivery tray sits inside upper-right map corner, limited to 17% width and 11% height. Camera keys small on map just above console at far right. Teal console frame, slim tidy dividers, no oversized bottom margin. Central left and right edges otherwise clear. This should feel like a classic expertly organized PC town-builder with integrated bottom controls. Make the flat single bottom bank an unmistakable signature.

designs.name: 좌측 건설형
designs.summary: 건설 목록은 왼쪽, 시설 정보는 오른쪽 아래
designs.tradeoff: 건물을 찾기 쉽고 세로 시야가 넓지만 지도의 가로 폭이 줄어듭니다.
designs.layout: OPTION LABEL '02 · 좌측 건설형'. TOP resource strip 7% screen height. A fixed LEFT CONSTRUCTION SIDEBAR 22% screen width from directly under top strip to bottom. Left sidebar title '건설', ONE narrow category row wrapping at most once, then compact two-column by three-row building card grid, then short '선택한 시설' hint at foot. Left construction panel MUST be visibly vertical, tall and not a horizontal shelf. MAIN MAP occupies right 78% screen width and essentially full height below top strip. NO full-width bottom construction tray. Four main actions sit in small bottom-center navigation bar within the MAP area, only 6% screen height. Small sawmill information panel attached to lower-right edge, 22% total-screen width and 23% height. A tiny objective/delivery tray at upper-right map. Time control directly under top strip near map's upper-left boundary (just right of sidebar). Camera four keys tiny above lower right inspector. Leave big visible open middle and high vertical map depth, consistent scale. The principal feeling is browsing a compact construction toolbox beside a large tall map.

designs.name: 우측 통합형
designs.tradeoff: 창이 흩어지지 않고 지도가 깔끔하지만 오른쪽 패널의 정보 밀도가 높습니다.
designs.layout: OPTION LABEL '03 · 우측 통합형'. The RIGHT 25% screen width is ONE continuous fixed vertical CONTROL CONSOLE from top to bottom, while LEFT 75% is a completely open large map viewport. No left sidebar. The map's TOP 7% has a compact region/resources row; time tiny upper-left below it. The right console begins with four action tabs '시장 건설 확장 세계', 건설 selected orange. Under that one compact horizontal objective/delivery summary only 10% height. Then '기초 주거 농축산 가공 운송' short category row; then two columns by three rows of building cards filling middle section. Right console LOWER third contains a clean compact sawmill inspector with progress and stop action, separated by teal header '선택한 시설'. All persistent panels, goals, build entries and inspector must stay inside the right rail, none floating over the map. Tiny camera keys at bottom-right corner of MAP viewport, not at far screen right. Help/settings at rail's bottom. No bottom navigation bar whatsoever. Keep right panel slightly more dense than other options but still legible and physically plausible, not an analytics dashboard. The left three-quarters should be strikingly unobstructed from top strip to bottom.

designs.name: 양쪽 분리형
designs.tradeoff: 건설과 생산 상태를 함께 보기 좋고, 넓은 모니터에 적합합니다.
designs.layout: OPTION LABEL '04 · 양쪽 분리형'. A thin TOP status bar 7% screen height spans entire screen: region left, resources center, time and settings right. Beneath it, a LEFT narrow 16% width CONSTRUCTION TOOLBOX and RIGHT 21% width OPERATIONS INSPECTOR flank a center map viewport 63% width. Left toolbox has '건설' title, compact category dropdown currently 기초 and a VERTICAL SINGLE COLUMN list of SIX building entries, each a small sprite left and name/cost right. Not a card grid! Left six rows use top/middle 60% height, a few small category shortcut tabs underneath, clean lower area with terrain toggle. Right rail top has compact goal and delivery, then sawmill inspector with a small sprite, recipe, actual resource slots, progress and stop key. Right rail bottom has small camera control strip, no giant map thumbnail. Four main navigation keys form a compact bar at BOTTOM CENTER OF MAP only; central map is visible from top to bottom otherwise. Two side panels align with viewport edges and do not hover. This is a specialist widescreen construction-and-production workstation expressed entirely as a real pixel game UI. Keep the central map large enough to show the road, sawmill, cottages and river; camera crop rather than shrink world sprites.

designs.name: 맵 집중형
designs.summary: 평소에는 지도 중심, 필요한 창만 작게 펼침
designs.tradeoff: 마을을 가장 넓게 볼 수 있지만 상세 정보는 눌러서 열어야 합니다.
designs.layout: OPTION LABEL '05 · 맵 집중형'. Full-bleed game map across screen with very minimal COMPACT FLOATING CORNER HUD. Top-left small region plaque and compact resources in one short row; top-right a single-line folded goal chip '개간 농노 · 0/12' and tiny delivery notification. Time sits just under top-left resource row. Bottom-center a very compact four-action dock '시장 건설 확장 세계', only 35% screen width and 6% screen height. '건설' is currently open and draws a SMALL floating construction palette directly ABOVE dock: width 39% screen and height 18%, one thin category row plus six SMALL compact icon tiles in ONE ROW. NOT a full-width bottom shelf, NOT giant cards. Leave both lower-left and lower-right map corners visibly open. A tiny sawmill context popover near the selected mill on the map, just to its right: max 17% screen width by 15% height, shows 제재소/생산 중, small log→plank and 65% meter, one slim stop key. Position it with a subtle short connector to building and avoid overlap with build palette. No permanent inspector/sidebar, no full-height panel anywhere. Camera controls as 2x2 compact squares at bottom-right screen, help/settings top-right. A tiny tools rail of 3 icons on left edge. At least three quarters of total image reads as visible game world. Render ONLY ONE expanded build palette and ONE small context card. Make the low visual weight and contextual interaction unmistakable.
